facts.fact: The universal service fund (FDSU) signed subsidy agreements in August 2026 with Vodacom, Airtel, Africell and Orange for at least 40 towers in peri-urban and rural areas, per a ministry communique.

systems.system: Fonds de développement du service universel (FDSU)

note: The Eastcastle tower financing is a commercial roll-out with no government part and is not recorded.
